verses.original: חָ֭כְמוֹת בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ חָצְבָ֖ה שִׁבְעָֽה׃ עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ
verses.literal: Wisdom has built her house she has carved out her seven pillars

verses.original: טָבְחָ֣ה טִ֭בְחָהּ מָסְכָ֣ה יֵינָ֑הּ אַ֝֗ף עָֽרְכָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנָֽהּ׃
verses.literal: She has prepared her meat [and] mixed her wine she has also set her table

verses.original: שָֽׁלְחָ֣ה נַעֲרֹתֶ֣יהָ תִקְרָ֑א עַל־ גַּ֝פֵּ֗י מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lə·ḥāh na·‘ă·rō·ṯe·hā ṯiq·rā ‘al- gap·pê mə·rō·mê qā·reṯ
verses.literal: She has sent out her maidservants she calls out from vvv the heights of the city

verses.original: מִי־ פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה אָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃ חֲסַר־ לֵ֝֗ב
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄e·ṯî yā·sur hên·nāh ’ā·mə·rāh lōw ḥă·sar- lêḇ
verses.literal: Whoever [is] simple let him turn in here she says to him who lacks judgment

verses.original: לְ֭כוּ לַחֲמ֣וּ בְֽלַחֲמִ֑י וּ֝שְׁת֗וּ בְּיַ֣יִן מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū la·ḥă·mū ḇə·la·ḥă·mî ū·šə·ṯū bə·ya·yin mā·sā·ḵə·tî
verses.literal: Come eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed

verses.original: פְתָאיִ֣ם עִזְב֣וּ וִֽחְי֑וּ וְ֝אִשְׁר֗וּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ בִּינָֽה׃
verses.literal: Leave your folly behind and you will live walk in the way of understanding

verses.original: יֹ֤סֵ֨ר׀ לֵ֗ץ לֹקֵ֣חַֽ קָל֑וֹן ל֣וֹ וּמוֹכִ֖יחַ לְרָשָׁ֣ע מוּמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·sêr lêṣ lō·qê·aḥ qā·lō·wn lōw ū·mō·w·ḵî·aḥ lə·rā·šā‘ mū·mōw
verses.literal: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself he who rebukes a wicked [man] taints himself

verses.original: אַל־ תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן־ יִשְׂנָאֶ֑ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·w·ḵaḥ lêṣ pen- yiś·nā·’e·kā hō·w·ḵaḥ lə·ḥā·ḵām wə·ye·’ĕ·hā·ḇe·kā
verses.literal: Do not rebuke a mocker or he will hate you rebuke a wise [man] and he will love you

verses.original: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭חָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־ ע֑וֹד הוֹדַ֥ע לְ֝צַדִּ֗יק וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶֽקַח׃פ
verses.transliteration: tên lə·ḥā·ḵām wə·yeḥ·kam- ‘ō·wḏ hō·w·ḏa‘ lə·ṣad·dîq wə·yō·w·sep̄ le·qaḥ
verses.literal: Instruct a wise man and he will be wiser still teach a righteous man and he will increase [his] learning

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה תְּחִלַּ֣ת חָ֭כְמָה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh tə·ḥil·laṯ ḥāḵ·māh wə·ḏa·‘aṯ qə·ḏō·šîm bî·nāh
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding

verses.original: כִּי־ בִ֭י יָמֶ֑יךָ יִרְבּ֣וּ שְׁנ֣וֹת וְיוֹסִ֥יפוּ חַיִּֽים׃ לְּ֝ךָ֗
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇî yā·me·ḵā yir·bū šə·nō·wṯ wə·yō·w·sî·p̄ū ḥay·yîm lə·ḵā
verses.literal: For through [wisdom] your days will be multiplied and years will be added to your life

verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥā·ḵam·tā ḥā·ḵam·tā lāḵ wə·laṣ·tā lə·ḇad·də·ḵā ṯiś·śā
verses.literal: If you are wise you are wise to your own advantage but if you scoff you alone will bear [the consequences]

verses.original: אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת יָ֥דְעָה וּבַל־ מָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·šeṯ kə·sî·lūṯ hō·mî·yāh pə·ṯay·yūṯ yā·ḏə·‘āh ū·ḇal- māh
verses.literal: The woman [named] Folly is loud [she is] naive and knows nothing . . .

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָשְׁבָה לְפֶ֣תַח בֵּיתָ֑הּ עַל־ כִּ֝סֵּ֗א מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šə·ḇāh lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ bê·ṯāh ‘al- kis·sê mə·rō·mê qā·reṯ
verses.literal: She sits at the door of her house on a seat in the heights of the city
calling out to those who pass by . . . who make their paths {straight}

verses.original: מִי־ פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃ וַחֲסַר־ לֵ֝֗ב
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄e·ṯî yā·sur hên·nāh wə·’ā·mə·rāh lōw wa·ḥă·sar- lêḇ
verses.literal: Whoever [is] simple let him turn in here she says to him who lacks judgment

verses.original: גְּנוּבִ֥ים מַֽיִם־ יִמְתָּ֑קוּ וְלֶ֖חֶם סְתָרִ֣ים יִנְעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gə·nū·ḇîm ma·yim- yim·tā·qū wə·le·ḥem sə·ṯā·rîm yin·‘ām
verses.literal: Stolen water is sweet and bread [eaten] in secret is tasty

verses.original: וְֽלֹא־ יָ֭דַע כִּֽי־ רְפָאִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם קְרֻאֶֽיהָ׃פ בְּעִמְקֵ֖י שְׁא֣וֹל
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ kî- rə·p̄ā·’îm šām qə·ru·’e·hā bə·‘im·qê šə·’ō·wl
verses.literal: But they do not know that the dead are there that her guests [are] in the depths of Sheol
